import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def get_color (t : Node) : Color :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c _ _ _ => c
  | Node.Empty => Color.Black -- Empty nodes are black

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def get_left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => some l | _ => none

def get_right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => some r | _ => none

def is_not_empty (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with | Node.Empty => False | _ => True

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_left_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  match t with
  | Node.Tree _ _ _ r =>
    -- Right child exists and is Red.
    -- (Dafny spec says Right is Red. Node itself can be any color).
    is_red r
  | _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Standard left rotation, made total: the right child is lifted to the root,
    keeping the old root's color, and the old root becomes a Red left child. -/
def rotate_left_impl (t : Node) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree _ rv rl rr) =>
      Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr
  | _ => t
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def rotate_left (t : Node) 
    (h_precond : rotate_left_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  rotate_left_impl t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_left_postcond (t : Node) (result : Node)
    (_ : rotate_left_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  view result = view t ∧
  is_bst t → is_bst result ∧
  match result, t with
  | Node.Tree c' _ l' _, Node.Tree c _ _ r =>
      -- New root color matches old root color
      c' = c ∧
      -- New left child matches old root and is RED
      (match l' with
       | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => True
       | _ => False) ∧
      -- Black height preservation
      (black_height t ≠ -1 → black_height result = black_height t)
  | _, _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
/-- The rotation preserves the set of stored values. -/
theorem view_rotate (c : Color) (v rv : Int) (l rl rr : Node) :
    view (Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr)
      = view (Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr)) := by
  simp only [view]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto

/-- Black height of a Red node, with the color test already evaluated. -/
theorem black_height_red (x : Int) (a b : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red x a b)
      = if black_height a ≠ -1 ∧ black_height b ≠ -1 ∧ black_height a = black_height b
        then black_height a else -1 := by
  simp only [black_height]
  all_goals rfl

/-- Black height of a Black node, with the color test already evaluated. -/
theorem black_height_black (x : Int) (a b : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black x a b)
      = if black_height a ≠ -1 ∧ black_height b ≠ -1 ∧ black_height a = black_height b
        then black_height a + 1 else -1 := by
  simp only [black_height]
  all_goals rfl

/-- The rotation preserves the black height (when it is well defined). -/
theorem black_height_rotate (c : Color) (v rv : Int) (l rl rr : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr)) ≠ -1 →
    black_height (Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr)
      = black_height (Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr)) := by
  intro h
  cases c <;>
    simp only [black_height_red, black_height_black] at h ⊢ <;>
    split_ifs at h ⊢ <;> omega
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem rotate_left_postcond_satisfied (t : Node)
    (h_precond : rotate_left_precond t) :
    rotate_left_postcond t (rotate_left t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  rcases t with _ | ⟨c, v, l, r⟩
  · simp only [rotate_left_precond] at h_precond
  · rcases r with _ | ⟨rc, rv, rl, rr⟩
    · simp [is_red] at h_precond
    · cases rc
      case Black => simp [is_red] at h_precond
      case Red =>
        simp only [rotate_left, rotate_left_impl, rotate_left_postcond]
        rintro ⟨-, hbst⟩
        simp only [is_bst] at hbst
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7⟩ := hbst
        have hvrv : v < rv := h3 rv (by simp only [view]; right; rfl)
        have hrl : ∀ x ∈ view rl, x > v := by
          intro x hx
          exact h3 x (by simp only [view]; left; left; exact hx)
        have hlt : ∀ x ∈ view (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl), x < rv := by
          intro x hx
          simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
          rcases hx with (hx | hx) | hx
          · exact lt_trans (h1 x hx) hvrv
          · exact h4 x hx
          · exact hx ▸ hvrv
        have hbh := black_height_rotate c v rv l rl rr
        refine ⟨⟨hlt, ⟨h1, h2, hrl, h5⟩, h6, h7⟩, ?_⟩
        exact ⟨trivial, trivial, hbh⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
llm_response.comment:
**`LEAN VERIFIED`** — the proof compiles with only two unused-variable warnings (one for `h_precond`, one pre-existing in the given postcondition).

What I did, all inside the marker regions of `Solution.lean`:

**auxcode** — `rotate_left_impl`, a total version of the standard left rotation:
`Tree c v l (Tree _ rv rl rr)  ↦  Tree c rv (Tree Red v l rl) rr`.
The new root keeps the old root's color `c`; the old root becomes the Red left child. Making it total (identity on other shapes) avoids a dependent match on `h_precond`; the precondition is still used in the proof to rule out those shapes.

**code** — `rotate_left t _ := rotate_left_impl t`.

**lemma** —
- `view_rotate`: the rotation preserves the stored set (proved by `ext` + `tauto`).
- `black_height_red` / `black_height_black`: `black_height` of a node with a *literal* color, with the `c == Color.Black` test already evaluated. These were the key step: with a literal color, `split_ifs` would otherwise split on `Color.Red == Color.Black` and produce a bogus branch (goal `A + 1 = A`) that `omega` could not discharge — that was the first failure the compiler reported.
- `black_height_rotate`: `cases c` then rewrite with the two lemmas, `split_ifs`, `omega`. Contradictory branches are closed via the hypothesis `black_height t ≠ -1`.

**proof** — case split on `t`; the `Empty`, empty-right, and Black-right cases contradict `rotate_left_precond` (`is_red r`). In the remaining case the postcondition's `∧`/`→` precedence makes the statement `(view result = view t ∧ is_bst t) → (is_bst result ∧ …)`, so `view result = view t` arrives as a hypothesis rather than a goal — I kept `view_rotate` in the lemma section since it's the property the description actually asks for, even though the goal as stated doesn't require it. BST preservation uses `v < rv` (from `rv ∈ view r`) and transitivity for the `view l` part; the color obligations are `True` after reduction; black height comes from `black_height_rotate`.
